title: Baskin Robbins
text:
Baskin Robbins is an ice-cream parlour located on the Scholars' Avenue next to Heritage and Cafe Coffee Day. -->

 History 

 Facilities and cuisines 
The place has a facility to sit for 8 people with extra chains put outside occasionally by the staff.

 Menu 
* Icecreams
** Mississippi Mud
** Bavarian Chocolate
** Black Currant
** and 28 others
* Hot Fudge, and others
